Our support team receives most tickets on Monday mornings. Many of them are about failed payments and the time it takes to get a refund.

Customers on the basic plan contact us more often than customers on the pro plan.
Some of them write twice before anyone answers.

We would like to know which customers are likely to leave in the next month, so that the team can reach out to them first.

The data comes from the billing system and from the ticket tool; both are exported every night.
